scripts.dev: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend,worker-api --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta "pnpm dev:frontend" "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:worker-api"
scripts.dev:full: concurrently --kill-others-on-fail --names frontend,backend,worker-api,worker-jobs --prefix-colors cyan,green,magenta,yellow "pnpm dev:frontend" "pnpm dev:backend" "pnpm dev:worker-api" "pnpm dev:worker-jobs"

scripts.infra:up: docker compose --env-file .env.root up -d postgres redis ollama
scripts.infra:down: docker compose --env-file .env.root stop postgres redis ollama
